name: Nuelink
desc: Social media scheduling: create, schedule, edit and track posts across your Nuelink brands and collections.

actions.name: create_collection_post
actions.description: Creates a post in a Nuelink collection as a draft, in the queue, at a scheduled time or right away. It goes to every channel in the collection.

actions.name: update_post
actions.description: Changes the caption of a post that is not published yet, turns it back into a draft, reschedules it or moves it in the queue.

actions.name: delete_post
actions.description: Permanently deletes a post from Nuelink. Anything already published on a social network stays there. Needs "Allow AI to perform sensitive actions" turned on in Nuelink Settings → API.

actions.name: list_posts
actions.description: Lists a brand's drafts, queued, scheduled and published posts, one page at a time.

actions.name: list_published_posts
actions.description: Lists what Nuelink sent to each channel, with the delivery status, the link to the post and its engagement counts.

actions.name: upload_media
actions.description: Uploads an image, video or PDF to the brand's Nuelink media library and returns its media ID for Create Post in Collection.

actions.name: createPost
actions.description: Adds a post to the collection linked to your Nuelink automation token. Needs an Automation Token connection; with an API key, use Create Post in Collection.

triggers.name: new_published_post
triggers.description: Fires when Nuelink publishes a post to a channel (or fails to, if you choose Failed). Runs once per channel.
